sentences.en: The king and his family live in the royal palace.
sentences.zh: 国王和他的家人住在王宫里。

sentences.en: Scores of people gathered in front of the Royal Palace.
sentences.zh: 成百上千的人聚集在皇家宫殿前。

sentences.en: The road of excess leads to the palace of wisdom.
sentences.zh: 放纵的道路通向智慧的宫殿。

senses.zh: 宫，宫殿,（主教）邸宅，宏伟大厦,华丽的娱乐场所
